name: read__fabric_scoped_projection
description: Locks per-fabric content projection: a FabricScopedReader cluster server (fabric_scoped_reader topology) returns the FabricIndex stamped into the dispatch context as the attribute value. Two scenarios drive the same OnOff attribute on two sessions with different FabricIndex values; each ReadRequest with FabricFiltered=true MUST receive a ReportData whose first AttributeDataIB carries the session-specific fabric ID. Without the session→fabric resolver, both reads would return the no-fabric fallback (0xFF). Locks the SessionFabricResolver + im.WithFabricFilter + FabricScopedReader.MatterReadFiltered chain end-to-end.
